repositories.name: codex
repositories.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repositories.summary: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的轻量级编程代理，运行在终端中，可协助用户完成编码任务。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repositories.summary: 一套面向真实工程实践的AI代理技能集，包含代码开发与效率工具，可通过插件或脚本快速安装使用。

repositories.name: ECC
repositories.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repositories.summary: ECC 是一个为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、规则和记忆等能力的性能优化系统。

repositories.name: superpowers
repositories.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repositories.summary: Superpowers 是一套面向编程代理的软件开发方法论，通过可组合技能和初始指令，让代理在编码前自动执行头脑风暴、测试驱动开发等流程。

repositories.name: sub2api
repositories.description: Sub2API 一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、Openai 、Gemini、Grok订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。
repositories.summary: Sub2API 是一个用 Go 编写的 AI API 网关平台，用于分发和管理 AI 产品订阅的 API 配额，支持多账户管理、计费、负载均衡和请求转发。

repositories.name: plane
repositories.description: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.
repositories.summary: Plane 是一个开源项目管理平台，用于跟踪任务、管理冲刺周期和产品路线图，支持自托管与云端部署。

repositories.name: n8n
repositories.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
repositories.summary: n8n 是一个支持自托管或云端的公平代码工作流自动化平台，可结合可视化画布与自定义代码，并内置 AI 能力，连接超过 1500 种集成。

repositories.name: claude-code
repositories.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
repositories.summary: Claude Code 是一个运行在终端中的智能编码工具，能理解代码库并通过自然语言执行常规任务、解释复杂代码和处理 Git 工作流。

repositories.name: OpenLogi
repositories.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repositories.summary: OpenLogi 是一个用 Rust 编写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品，支持跨平台鼠标按键重映射、DPI 调整和 SmartShift 等功能。

repositories.name: modular
repositories.summary: Modular平台的开源仓库，包含MAX框架与Mojo语言，用于AI开发与部署。

repositories.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
repositories.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repositories.summary: 一个基于Karpathy观察的CLAUDE.md文件，通过四条原则改善Claude Code的编码行为。

repositories.name: google-timeline-visualizer
repositories.description: Visualize your year in travel using your Google Location History (Timeline) data
repositories.summary: 一个将Google位置历史时间线数据转换为旅行动画视频的Android应用，支持选择日期、预览并生成MP4视频。

repositories.name: free-for-dev
repositories.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repositories.summary: 这是一个汇集了提供免费开发者层级的SaaS、PaaS和IaaS服务的列表，方便开发运维人员查找和使用。

repositories.name: TypeScript
repositories.description: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JavaScript output.
repositories.summary: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，通过添加可选类型支持大型应用开发，并编译为可读的标准 JavaScript 代码。

repositories.name: plugins
repositories.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repositories.summary: Cursor 官方插件仓库，包含面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的插件规范与实现，每个插件独立目录并带有清单文件。

repositories.name: posthog
repositories.description: 🦔 PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. Our developer tools – AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and more – capture all the context agents need to diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and ship fixes. Steer it all from Slack, web, desktop, or the MCP.
repositories.summary: PostHog 是一个开源产品分析平台，提供事件追踪、会话回放、功能开关和实验等工具，帮助团队构建和优化产品。

repositories.name: AI-Infra-Guard
repositories.description: A full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems via Agent Scan, Skills Scan, MCP scan, AI Infra scan and LLM jailbreak evaluation.
repositories.summary: AI-Infra-Guard 是一个全栈 AI 红队平台，用于扫描 AI 智能体、技能、MCP 服务器及基础设施，并评估大语言模型的越狱风险。
